# Arkansas Automated

> Arkansas Automated is operated by Brassfield Ventures LLC in Fort Smith. It is not Arkansas Automated Security, LLC of Mayflower. The homepage front door is the AI operations audit: $999, ninety minutes, a written map of the leaks ranked by payback. The fee credits toward a build started within 60 days. Visibility Install is a named build, not the homepage: five fixes on the website the customer already has, $2,500 to start, then $497 a month for 90 days. It does not answer the phone. The AI front desk is a different job at the same published dollars ($2,500 setup + $497/mo) and does answer the phone. Other public prices: Front Door $497, Front Door Wired $1,497, workflow builds $1,500 to $5,000 setup, embedded retainer from $2,000/mo. Public workshop seats are not for sale. Phone (479) 282-3121.

- [Visibility Install](https://arkansasautomated.com/services/visibility-install): five fixes on an existing site, $2,500 to start, then $497 a month for 90 days. Does not answer the phone.

- [Vendra](https://arkansasautomated.com/vendra): shopping-center sales reporting for malls and merchants. An Arkansas Automated product. Activation uses a store-specific /join/[token] link issued by the mall team.

- [Problems we fix](https://arkansasautomated.com/fix): missed calls, after-hours calls, quote follow-up, double entry, no-shows

## Key locations

Every city below has an AI receptionist page at /ai-receptionist/[city] and a workshops page at /ai-workshops/[city].

- River Valley: [Fort Smith](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-receptionist/fort-smith) (home base), Van Buren, Russellville
- Northwest Arkansas: [Fayetteville](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-receptionist/fayetteville), Springdale, [Rogers](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-receptionist/rogers), [Bentonville](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-receptionist/bentonville), Bella Vista, Siloam Springs
- Central Arkansas: [Little Rock](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-receptionist/little-rock), North Little Rock, [Conway](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-receptionist/conway), Jacksonville, Cabot, Benton, Bryant, Hot Springs, Searcy
- Northeast Arkansas and the Delta: Jonesboro, Paragould, Batesville, West Memphis
- South and Southwest Arkansas: Texarkana, El Dorado, Pine Bluff
